what: When hovering a cell in a horizontal row (such as the four divisions or services), that cell’s large photo turns on across the full row width in .3s, while the names and buttons of the other cells vanish in .2s so only the hovered cell’s name stays over the large photo. Leaving the row turns the large photo off and brings all names back. Disabled at 650px and below (cells stack vertically) and on touch screens

options.min: Turned off at or below this width (px), default 650 — 0 keeps it always on

use:
Large Photo 1
Large Photo 2
Cell photoName 1Cell photoName 2
note: Place the big photo (photo) in the same order as the column (col) — the nth photo for the nth column. Duration is changed with --fx-photo-dur and --fx-info-dur. The column divider lines are drawn separately over the photo by the consumer (the original has three white 1px vertical lines)

from.where: index.js · index.html .sr-cols (original .p-worksWrap — four division columns, on mouseenter .p-worksWrap__bg__image opacity · .p-worksWrap__info opacity)
